LanguageData.LP_MythicDrill.label: mythic deep drill
LanguageData.LP_MythicDrill.description: A dwarven-style deep drill: gold-seeking runes are carved on the drill rod, which, guided by a silver probe, passes through the rock layers to reach fine mithril and adamantine veins buried deep in the crust that don't show on the map. Needs power and a pawn operating it as mining work; drilling speed and yield are based on the operator's deep drilling speed and mining yield, like the vanilla deep drill.\n\nNeeds no deep deposits; it can drill anywhere and can be moved at any time. Each full portion drilled (1.5× the work of the vanilla deep drill): 75% for 7 mithril, 25% for 3 adamantine; mithril doubled when a dwarf operates it. Attracts insectoids like the vanilla deep drill.
